intelligence.enrichment: A shadow is the dark region on a screen where light does not reach because an object blocks light falling on that screen. When an object blocks light from reaching a surface, the blocked region on that surface becomes a shadow; stronger blocking produces a darker shadow. The learner correctly applies this rule: A shadow is the dark region on a screen where light does not reach because an object blocks light falling on that screen. A shadow is just the dark color of the object copied onto the wall.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Light.
